def solve(a,b):
    m=len(a); n=len(b)
    dp=list(range(n+1))
    for i in range(1,m+1):
        prev=dp[0]; dp[0]=i
        for j in range(1,n+1):
            cur=dp[j]
            cost=0 if a[i-1]==b[j-1] else 1
            dp[j]=min(dp[j]+1, dp[j-1]+1, prev+cost)
            prev=cur
    return dp[n]
